channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: 50,000 at Western Wall Selichot: Captivity survivors Kupershtein and Berger participate
item.description: Some 50,000 people attend second Selichot service at the Western Wall, praying for the safety of IDF soldiers and the security of Israel.

item.title: Dozens of haredim protest at Maccabim Checkpoint following arrest of draft evader
item.description:
Dozens of extremist haredim protested at the Maccabim Checkpoint near Modi’in, in protest of the arrest of a draft evader.
The evader was detained by police near the Beit Gamzu Junction and was later transferred to Military Police custody.

item.title: Woman charged with plotting ISIS-inspired attack on New York Capitol
item.description: Albany woman charged after allegedly plotting an ISIS-inspired attack on New York's Capitol and seeking explosives and a gun.

item.title: Soccer: Hapoel Tel Aviv draws with Atalanta, Maccabi Tel Aviv loses to Lugano
item.description:
Hapoel Tel Aviv on Thursday evening played to a 0-0 draw away to Italian side Atalanta in Bergamo in the first leg of the Conference League playoff round.
Meanwhile, Maccabi Tel Aviv lost 2-1 to Lugano in Switzerland and will need to win the second leg next week to overturn the deficit and advance to the league phase of the competition.

item.title: Watch | Netanyahu at pop star Eden Ben Zaken’s concert: Am Yisrael Chai
item.description: Prime Minister speaks with the singer during her concert: “It’s wonderful to be with our amazing people and with you."

item.title: Ben Gurion strike fallout | Netanyahu orders removal of Airport Workers’ chief from Likud
item.description: Netanyahu’s associates furious over the move by Pinchas Idan, chairman of the Israel Airports Authority workers’ union, prompting the Prime Minister to order his removal from Likud.

item.title: A Jewish Soul's Journey From In The Army To At Home
item.description: From war and the struggle with the enemy to marriage, education and mutual responsibility: a journey through the three circles of the Jewish soul.

item.title: 'Hamas hasn't changed': Huckabee on Israel, Trump and the Middle East
item.description: In a special Arutz Sheva interview, US Ambassador Mike Huckabee speaks out on Iran, Hamas, Syria, Israel's upcoming elections, and Trump-Netanyahu ties.

item.title: Deri warns: “They are fighting to destroy us from within"
item.description: Shas chairman launches the party’s election campaign with harsh accusations against elements within the Haredi community who, he claims, are acting on behalf of the left to harm the right-wing bloc.

item.title: Seven countries warn against Israel's E1 plan
item.description: UK, France, Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Canada and Norway condemn the E1 tenders, warning they could damage the two-state solution and Israel's international standing.

item.title: “Enormous economic power:" Porush warns business leaders of haredi boycott
item.description: MK Meir Porush threatened to use the sector’s purchasing power, estimated at tens of billions of shekels, if what he described as the “persecution of the Haredim" continues.

item.title: Bereaved parents hit back at Eisenkot over October 7 probe
item.description: Families bereaved on October 7 accuse supporters of a state commission of inquiry of seeking a political outcome, demanding an independent panel with coalition and opposition agreement.

item.title: New York has become Habibi City
item.description: The city that saw the towers fall under the weight of planes piloted by men who invoked Allah has elected a mayor who bows to the same cultural tradition that speaks the language of those who, in other latitudes, consider the West an enemy. Opinion.

item.title: Ben Gurion Airport disruptions targeted Miri Regev
item.description: Senior Israel Airports Authority officials claim that workers’ committee chairman Pinchas Idan planned to disrupt the Transportation Minister’s flight to Morocco, but ultimately postponed the strike by one day.

item.title: Supreme Court rejects petition against illegal scrapyards
item.description: Regavim warns illegal scrapyards are fueling car theft and security threats after the Supreme Court accepts the state’s claim that sufficient enforcement measures have been taken.

item.title: Sheikh who fought Hezbollah: “They brought ruin upon Lebanon"
item.description: Sheikh Muhammad Ali al-Fouani accuses Iran of brainwashing the disadvantaged population and claims that international pressure would lead to Hezbollah’s rapid collapse.

item.title: Smotrich to Eisenkot: Will you commit that there will be no Palestinian state?
item.description: Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich called on Gadi Eisenkot to clarify his positions regarding interference by foreign countries, continued construction in Judea and Samaria, and the establishment of a Palestinian state.

item.title: Colombia: Last trapped people rescued at sites where Israeli teams operated
item.description:
IDF humanitarian delegation teams in Colombia, working alongside local rescue forces, located and rescued all missing people at the impact sites in which they operated and continue to assist at other impact sites.
In addition, the delegation’s members continue a central effort to assess buildings and conduct professional surveys of damaged structures, in order to assist decision-makers in the city in developing an up-to-date situational assessment. In this way, the delegation’s experts are enabling educational and healthcare institutions to resume operations, allowing the city to return to normal functioning as soon as possible.
To date, dozens of buildings have been surveyed; most have been approved for use, while some have been deemed unsafe. Just yesterday, the delegation’s experts approved the safe return of more than 250 families to their homes.

item.title: Jewish Terrorism?: Amb. Huckabee explains what he condemns - and what he supports
item.description: US Ambassador Mike Huckabee lays out the true effects of violent extremism in Judea and Samaria in an exclusive interview with Arutz Sheva.

item.title: Haredi man attacked by 6 assailants in Borough Park
item.description: New York police were called to the scene following a report from Shomrim volunteers, arrested the suspects for questioning, and led them away from the scene in handcuffs.

item.title: Ben Gurion Airport: Baggage conveyors are back in operation, check-in counters have reopened
item.description: At Ben Gurion Airport, the baggage conveyors are back in operation, and the check-in counters have reopened.

item.title: After a week of searching, missing man found dead
item.description: The body of Katriel Nachman Keinan, 24, from Beit Shemesh, was found in difficult terrain in the area of the Switzerland Forest in Tiberias after more than a week of searches.

item.title: Amb. Huckabee: 'We have said to Hamas - your time is up'
item.description: The US ambassador to Israel defends direct talks with Hamas, saying Kushner delivered a blunt message: disarm, demilitarize and accept that they would need to leave Gaza.

item.title: Chilling: The words Yehuda Katz wrote
item.description: A summary of a Torah lesson written by Yehuda Katz in his youth takes on chilling significance.

item.title: The race against time: Firefighters race to rescue traped eagle owl
item.description: Firefighters race to rescue eagle owl trapped in bird net, racing against time and the risk of dehydration and deterioration.

item.title: When peace breeds complacency
item.description: The Torah's lesson is one Israel learned tragically on October 7: Do not mistake quiet for a permanent change in the intentions of those who wish us harm.

item.title: The favors of bad people
item.description: It is painful to note that, today, the degree of assimilation in the USA is such that, in the not distant future, the once robust American Jewish community will be a shell of its former self.

item.description: The Prime Minister addressed the surprise strike and severe disruptions at Ben Gurion Airport and made clear that the airport would operate normally.
